notes: One logical opposite-direction XAU/XAG turn-of-month basket. The EA freezes a synchronized three-completed-month average-return rank before the cycle, buys the higher-return metal, shorts the lower, and evaluates combined package PnL and costs at Q02.
The logical basket must never be decomposed into standalone XAU or XAG gate results. One RISK_FIXED budget is split equally by per-leg ATR stop risk.
